```{=html}
<style>

/* Remove all Quarto width restrictions from this page */
html,
body,
#quarto-content,
.quarto-container,
.page-columns,
main.content,
#quarto-document-content {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Remove any empty page-title area */
.quarto-title-block {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Make the resume viewer fill the entire screen below the navbar */
.resume-full-page {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 72px;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: calc(100vh - 72px) !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  z-index: 900;
  opacity: 1 !important;
  filter: none !important;
  transform: none !important;
  background-color: #202124;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Make the actual PDF viewer fill its entire container */
.resume-full-page iframe {
  width: 100vw !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  min-width: 100vw !important;
  min-height: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: block !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  background-color: #202124;
}

</style>

<div class="resume-full-page">

  <iframe
    src="Soha_Arian_Resume%20%282%29.pdf#page=1&zoom=page-width"
    title="Soha Arian Resume">
  </iframe>

</div>

<script>

/* Automatically position the PDF directly beneath the real navbar */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const resumeViewer =
    document.querySelector(".resume-full-page");

  const websiteHeader =
    document.querySelector("#quarto-header");

  function resizeResumeViewer() {

    const headerBottom = websiteHeader
      ? websiteHeader.getBoundingClientRect().bottom
      : 72;

    resumeViewer.style.top =
      headerBottom + "px";

    resumeViewer.style.height =
      "calc(100vh - " + headerBottom + "px)";

  }

  resizeResumeViewer();

  window.addEventListener(
    "resize",
    resizeResumeViewer
  );

});

</script>
```
